prima_materia_raw: Crimson rain falls over a settlement.
psych_pathology_raw: Witnesses seek certainty in incompatible explanations.
atmospherics_raw: Wet roofs, red runoff, metallic smell.

scene_hooks.hook_text_raw: An outside chronicler might record the crimson rain as a plague omen, while internal documents could interpret the same event as evidence that a supernatural opening has occurred.
